blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, BOHOL, Philippines — Cebu Archbishop Alberto “Abet” Uy raised serious concerns over the Philippines’ participation in Pax Silica, warning that the partnership could have long-term consequences for the country’s environment, water supply, energy resources and national interests. In a statement posted on his social media account on Monday night, Nov. 16, Uy questioned whether the partnership would genuinely benefit ordinary Filipinos or leave the country sacrificing its natural resources while other parties reap most of the benefits.
